automation.description: Used by the recorder round-trip test: a user in an already signed-in PrimeFaces (tablet UX/UI) session makes a lookup value, opens it from two list grids, fills in widgets and runs actions, while the recorder writes a script of what was done, which is then replayed.

interaction.name: Lookup values
interaction.description: Creates a lookup value whose description sorts first in its list.

interaction.name: List Grid Fixture: a Vue list grid and a PrimeFaces data table
interaction.description: Opens that lookup value from both the Vue list grid and the PrimeFaces data table on the List Grid Fixture, checks its description each time, then deletes it from the Lookup values list.

interaction.name: Widgets
interaction.description: Fills in checkbox, combo, radio, number, text and memo widgets on the Kitchen Sink Widgets tab and checks the combo and text values.

method.comment: A menu click is the next gesture, so the entries above are recorded before it

interaction.name: Actions and tabs
interaction.description: Runs the Actions Fixture's toolbar, form button and tab button actions, checking the outcome each time.

method.comment: Tab button is the first tab: select another first, as selecting the shown tab does nothing
